summaries.pt-BR: Corte um texto em uma lista a cada nova linha, vírgula ou separador personalizado, e o próximo nó é executado uma vez por item, como uma imagem por linha.

nodes.label: Prompt
nodes.summary: Generate, rewrite or summarize text with Gemini, Claude, GPT or Grok. Add instructions, images, video or audio, and split the answer into items.

summaries.en: Generate, rewrite or summarize text with Gemini, Claude, GPT or Grok. Add instructions, images, video or audio, and split the answer into items.
summaries.ja: Gemini、Claude、GPT、Grok でテキストを生成、書き直し、要約します。指示や画像、動画、オーディオを加えられ、回答を複数の項目に分割することもできます。
summaries.pt-BR: Gere, reescreva ou resuma textos com Gemini, Claude, GPT ou Grok. Adicione instruções, imagens, vídeo ou áudio e divida a resposta em itens.

nodes.label: List
nodes.summary: Type or paste a list of prompts, or build a table with several columns, and every connected node runs once per row. The List node itself is free.

summaries.en: Type or paste a list of prompts, or build a table with several columns, and every connected node runs once per row. The List node itself is free.
summaries.ja: プロンプトのリストを入力するか貼り付けるか、複数の列を持つ表を作ると、接続したすべてのノードが行ごとに 1 回ずつ実行されます。リストノード自体は無料です。
summaries.pt-BR: Digite ou cole uma lista de prompts, ou monte uma tabela com várias colunas, e cada nó conectado é executado uma vez por linha. O nó Lista é gratuito.

nodes.label: Collect
nodes.summary: Gather the results of several nodes in one place. Collect sorts them into text, image, video and audio outputs that connect to any node, for free.

summaries.en: Gather the results of several nodes in one place. Collect sorts them into text, image, video and audio outputs that connect to any node, for free.
summaries.ja: 複数のノードの結果を 1 か所に集めます。収集は結果をテキスト、画像、動画、オーディオの出力に分け、どのノードにも接続できるようにします。料金は無料です。
summaries.pt-BR: Reúna os resultados de vários nós em um só lugar. O Coletar é gratuito e os separa em saídas de texto, imagem, vídeo e áudio que se conectam a qualquer nó.

nodes.label: Selector
nodes.summary: Pick one item or a subset from a list by position, range, random sample, rule or name. Selector sends the pick and the rest to two outputs, for free.

summaries.en: Pick one item or a subset from a list by position, range, random sample, rule or name. Selector sends the pick and the rest to two outputs, for free.
summaries.ja: 位置、範囲、ランダムなサンプル、ルール、名前を使って、リストから 1 つの項目や一部の項目を選びます。選んだ項目と残りを 2 つの出力に分けて送ります。無料です。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um item ou um subconjunto de uma lista por posição, intervalo, sorteio, regra ou nome. O nó é gratuito e envia a escolha e o resto a duas saídas.

nodes.label: Filter List
nodes.summary: Keep only the list items that match your conditions, such as a field that contains a word or a date since the last run. Combine rules with AND or OR.

summaries.en: Keep only the list items that match your conditions, such as a field that contains a word or a date since the last run. Combine rules with AND or OR.
summaries.ja: 特定の語を含むフィールドや、前回の実行以降の日付など、条件に一致するリストの項目だけを残します。複数のルールは AND または OR で組み合わせます。
summaries.pt-BR: Mantenha só os itens de uma lista que atendem às suas condições, como um campo com uma palavra ou uma data desde a última execução. Use AND ou OR.

nodes.label: Sort List
nodes.summary: Put a list in order by the whole item or by a field such as score or created_at, comparing as text, numbers or dates, ascending or descending.

summaries.en: Put a list in order by the whole item or by a field such as score or created_at, comparing as text, numbers or dates, ascending or descending.
summaries.ja: リストの項目を、項目全体か score や created_at などのフィールドで並べ替えます。テキスト・数値・日付として比較し、昇順か降順かを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Ordene uma lista pelo item inteiro ou por um campo, como score ou created_at, comparando como texto, números ou datas, em ordem crescente ou decrescente.

nodes.label: Remove Duplicates
nodes.summary: Remove repeated items from a list and keep the first copy of each. Compare whole items or one field, such as id or url, in scraped or merged lists.

summaries.en: Remove repeated items from a list and keep the first copy of each. Compare whole items or one field, such as id or url, in scraped or merged lists.
summaries.ja: リストから重複した項目を取り除き、それぞれ最初の 1 つを残します。スクレイピングや結合で作ったリストを、項目全体か、id や url などのフィールドで比較できます。
summaries.pt-BR: Remova os itens repetidos e mantenha a primeira cópia de cada um. Compare itens inteiros ou um campo, como id ou url, em listas extraídas ou mescladas.

nodes.label: Merge Lists
nodes.summary: Combine several lists into one. Concatenate appends them in connection order, and Zip merges the items that share a position. Optionally drop duplicates.

summaries.en: Combine several lists into one. Concatenate appends them in connection order, and Zip merges the items that share a position. Optionally drop duplicates.
summaries.ja: 複数のリストを 1 つにまとめます。「連結」は接続した順番にリストをつなげ、「Zip」は同じ位置の項目どうしを結合します。結合後に重複を削除することもできます。
summaries.pt-BR: Combine várias listas em uma. Concatenar as junta na ordem das conexões, e Emparelhar mescla os itens da mesma posição. Descartar duplicatas é opcional.

nodes.label: Choose Best
nodes.summary: Turn many results into one. An AI judge picks the best image or text against your criteria, or the node joins, counts, votes on or merges the results.

summaries.en: Turn many results into one. An AI judge picks the best image or text against your criteria, or the node joins, counts, votes on or merges the results.
summaries.ja: 多数の結果を 1 つにまとめます。AI の審査員が基準に沿って最も良い画像やテキストを選ぶほか、結果の結合、カウント、多数決、マージもできます。
summaries.pt-BR: Transforme muitos resultados em um. Um juiz de IA escolhe a melhor imagem ou texto pelos seus critérios, ou o nó junta, conta, vota ou mescla resultados.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.summary: Send a workflow down one or more named routes. Choose the route yourself, turn several on at once, or let conditions on the incoming data decide.

summaries.en: Send a workflow down one or more named routes. Choose the route yourself, turn several on at once, or let conditions on the incoming data decide.
summaries.ja: ワークフローの流れを、名前を付けた 1 つ以上のルートに振り分けます。ルートを自分で選ぶか、複数を同時に有効にするか、受け取ったデータの条件で決めます。
summaries.pt-BR: Envie um workflow por uma ou mais rotas nomeadas. Escolha a rota você mesmo, ative várias de uma vez ou deixe que condições nos dados recebidos decidam.

nodes.label: Extract Field
nodes.summary: Pull one field or a nested path, such as title or authorMeta.name, out of JSON data, and send it on as text, as a list to run once per item, or as JSON.

summaries.en: Pull one field or a nested path, such as title or authorMeta.name, out of JSON data, and send it on as text, as a list to run once per item, or as JSON.
summaries.ja: title や authorMeta.name のようなフィールドやネストしたパスを JSON データから取り出し、テキスト、項目ごとに実行するためのリスト、または JSON として送ります。
summaries.pt-BR: Tire um campo ou um caminho aninhado, como title ou authorMeta.name, de dados JSON e envie como texto, como lista para executar por item ou como JSON.

nodes.label: QA Check
nodes.summary: Score a text from 0 to 1 with an AI model for content, quality, consistency or safety, and get an approved or rejected decision with a short reason.

summaries.en: Score a text from 0 to 1 with an AI model for content, quality, consistency or safety, and get an approved or rejected decision with a short reason.
summaries.ja: AI モデルでテキストを内容、品質、一貫性、安全性の観点から 0〜1 で採点し、承認か却下かの判定を短い理由とともに受け取ります。
summaries.pt-BR: Um modelo de IA dá ao texto uma nota de 0 a 1 em conteúdo, qualidade, consistência ou segurança, e decide se aprova ou rejeita, com um motivo curto.

nodes.label: JSON Process
nodes.summary: JSON Process is a legacy node that filters and reshapes JSON. It is no longer in the node picker, but saved workflows keep running. Use Extract Field instead.

summaries.en: JSON Process is a legacy node that filters and reshapes JSON. It is no longer in the node picker, but saved workflows keep running. Use Extract Field instead.
summaries.ja: JSON 処理は、JSON をフィルターして整形するレガシーノードです。ノードピッカーからはなくなりましたが、保存済みのワークフローでは引き続き動作します。代わりにフィールドを抽出を使ってください。
summaries.pt-BR: Processar JSON é um nó legado que filtra e remodela JSON. Ele saiu do menu “Adicionar nó”, mas os workflows salvos seguem funcionando. Use o Extrair campo.

nodes.label: Sub-Workflow
nodes.summary: Put a whole workflow inside another as one node with typed inputs and outputs. Create a new one in place or reuse an existing workflow, up to 5 levels deep.

summaries.en: Put a whole workflow inside another as one node with typed inputs and outputs. Create a new one in place or reuse an existing workflow, up to 5 levels deep.
summaries.ja: ワークフロー全体を、種類付きの入力と出力を持つ 1 つのノードとして別のワークフローに入れます。その場で新しく作ることも既存のワークフローを再利用することもでき、最大 5 階層まで入れ子にできます。
summaries.pt-BR: Coloque um workflow inteiro dentro de outro como um nó, com entradas e saídas tipadas. Crie um novo ali mesmo ou reutilize um existente, com até 5 níveis.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.summary: Add a published component, a versioned workflow from the community or your own, as one node. Set its inputs and settings, and it runs as a black box.

summaries.en: Add a published component, a versioned workflow from the community or your own, as one node. Set its inputs and settings, and it runs as a black box.
summaries.ja: 公開済みのコンポーネントを 1 つのノードとして追加します。コミュニティや自分が作った、バージョン管理されたワークフローです。入力と設定を指定すると、ブラックボックスとして実行されます。
summaries.pt-BR: Adicione como nó um componente publicado, um workflow com versões da comunidade ou seu. Defina entradas e configurações; ele é executado como caixa-preta.

nodes.label: Sub-Workflow Input
nodes.summary: Define the inputs of a workflow that other workflows call as a Sub-Workflow. Each port has a name and a type, and pairs with a Sub-Workflow Output by route.

summaries.en: Define the inputs of a workflow that other workflows call as a Sub-Workflow. Each port has a name and a type, and pairs with a Sub-Workflow Output by route.
summaries.ja: ほかのワークフローからサブワークフローとして呼び出すワークフローの入力を定義します。名前と種類を持つコネクタを並べ、ルートでサブワークフロー出力と組み合わせます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina as entradas de um workflow que outros chamam como sub-workflow. Cada conector tem nome e tipo, e a rota pareia o nó com uma Saída do sub-workflow.

nodes.label: Sub-Workflow Output
nodes.summary: Define what a callable workflow returns. Pair it with a Sub-Workflow Input, add typed output ports, and choose which result the caller shows as its preview.

summaries.en: Define what a callable workflow returns. Pair it with a Sub-Workflow Input, add typed output ports, and choose which result the caller shows as its preview.
summaries.ja: 呼び出し可能なワークフローが返すものを定義します。サブワークフロー入力と組み合わせ、種類付きの出力コネクタを追加して、呼び出し元がプレビューに表示する結果を選びます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina o que um workflow chamado como sub-workflow devolve. Pareie o nó com uma Entrada do sub-workflow, crie conectores tipados e escolha a prévia.

nodes.label: Group
nodes.summary: Drag nodes into a Group frame to organize the canvas. Color it to mark a section, and use its outputs to pass the members' results on by type.

summaries.en: Drag nodes into a Group frame to organize the canvas. Color it to mark a section, and use its outputs to pass the members' results on by type.
summaries.ja: ノードをグループの枠にドラッグして、キャンバスを整理します。色を付けてセクションを示し、出力を使ってメンバーの結果を種類ごとに次へ渡せます。
summaries.pt-BR: Arraste nós para o quadro de um Grupo e organize o canvas. Dê uma cor para marcar uma seção e use as saídas para repassar os resultados dos nós por tipo.

nodes.label: Teleport Send
nodes.summary: Broadcast a value on a lettered channel, and every Teleport Receive tuned to that channel gets it, with no connection line drawn across the canvas.

summaries.en: Broadcast a value on a lettered channel, and every Teleport Receive tuned to that channel gets it, with no connection line drawn across the canvas.
summaries.ja: 文字で区別されるチャンネルに値を送ると、そのチャンネルに合わせたすべてのテレポート受信が、キャンバスに接続線を引かずにその値を受け取ります。
summaries.pt-BR: Transmita um valor em um canal com letra: todo Receber por teleporte sintonizado nesse canal o recebe, sem nenhuma linha de conexão cruzando o canvas.

nodes.label: Teleport Receive
nodes.summary: Receive the value that a Teleport Send broadcasts on the same channel, anywhere on the canvas and without a connection line. Switch channels at any time.

summaries.en: Receive the value that a Teleport Send broadcasts on the same channel, anywhere on the canvas and without a connection line. Switch channels at any time.
summaries.ja: テレポート送信が同じチャンネルで送る値を、キャンバスのどこでも、接続線なしで受け取ります。チャンネルはいつでも切り替えられます。
summaries.pt-BR: Receba o valor que um Enviar por teleporte transmite no mesmo canal, em qualquer lugar do canvas e sem linha de conexão. Troque de canal quando quiser.

nodes.label: Preview
nodes.summary: Preview shows the results of connected nodes, text, images, video and audio, in one place. Today every node shows its own result, so most workflows skip it.

summaries.en: Preview shows the results of connected nodes, text, images, video and audio, in one place. Today every node shows its own result, so most workflows skip it.
summaries.ja: プレビューは、接続したノードの結果（テキスト、画像、動画、オーディオ）を 1 か所に表示します。現在は各ノードが自分の結果を表示するため、ほとんどのワークフローでは使いません。
summaries.pt-BR: A Prévia reúne em um lugar o texto, as imagens, o vídeo e o áudio de nós conectados. Hoje todo nó mostra o próprio resultado, e poucos workflows a usam.

nodes.label: Sticky Note
nodes.summary: Put a note anywhere on the canvas to label a section, explain a step or leave instructions. Sticky notes have no inputs or outputs and never affect a run.

summaries.en: Put a note anywhere on the canvas to label a section, explain a step or leave instructions. Sticky notes have no inputs or outputs and never affect a run.
summaries.ja: キャンバスの好きな場所に付箋を置き、セクションに名前を付けたり、手順を説明したり、指示を残したりします。付箋には入力も出力もなく、実行に影響しません。
summaries.pt-BR: Ponha uma nota em qualquer ponto do canvas para rotular seções, explicar etapas ou deixar instruções. Sem entradas nem saídas, ela nunca afeta a execução.

nodes.label: Publish to Social
nodes.summary: Post an image, a video or text to any social account you connected, from one node. Pick the account and the node sets the platform and its post options.

summaries.en: Post an image, a video or text to any social account you connected, from one node. Pick the account and the node sets the platform and its post options.
summaries.ja: 接続済みのどの SNS アカウントにも、1 つのノードで画像、動画、テキストを投稿できます。アカウントを選ぶと、ノードがプラットフォームとその投稿オプションを設定します。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique imagem, vídeo ou texto em qualquer conta de rede social conectada, com um só nó. Escolha a conta, e o nó define a plataforma e as opções do post.

nodes.label: Instagram Post
nodes.summary: Publish an image, a Reel, a Story or a carousel to your Instagram Business or Creator account from a workflow, with a caption of up to 2,200 characters.

summaries.en: Publish an image, a Reel, a Story or a carousel to your Instagram Business or Creator account from a workflow, with a caption of up to 2,200 characters.
summaries.ja: ワークフローから、Instagram のビジネスアカウントやクリエイターアカウントに、画像、リール、ストーリーズ、カルーセルを公開します。キャプションは最大 2,200 文字です。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique imagem, Reel, Story ou carrossel na sua conta comercial ou de criador do Instagram a partir de um workflow, com legenda de até 2.200 caracteres.

nodes.label: TikTok Post
nodes.summary: Publish a video from your workflow to a connected TikTok account with a caption. Use vertical 1080 × 1920 video of up to 10 minutes for the best result.

summaries.en: Publish a video from your workflow to a connected TikTok account with a caption. Use vertical 1080 × 1920 video of up to 10 minutes for the best result.
summaries.ja: ワークフローの動画を、キャプションを付けて、接続済みの TikTok アカウントに公開します。最適な結果を得るには、最大 10 分の縦長 1080 × 1920 の動画を使います。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique um vídeo do workflow na sua conta conectada do TikTok, com legenda. Use vídeo vertical de 1080 × 1920 e até 10 minutos para o melhor resultado.

nodes.label: YouTube Upload
nodes.summary: Upload a video or a Short to your YouTube channel from a workflow, with a title, a description, tags and a privacy setting that starts as Private.

summaries.en: Upload a video or a Short to your YouTube channel from a workflow, with a title, a description, tags and a privacy setting that starts as Private.
summaries.ja: ワークフローから、YouTube チャンネルに動画やショートをアップロードします。タイトル、説明、タグ、公開設定を指定でき、公開設定の初期値は「非公開」です。
summaries.pt-BR: Envie um vídeo ou um Short do seu workflow ao seu canal do YouTube, com título, descrição e tags. A configuração de privacidade começa em Privado.

nodes.label: Facebook Post
nodes.summary: Publish text, an image, a video or a Story to your connected Facebook account from a workflow, with a caption of up to 63,206 characters.

summaries.en: Publish text, an image, a video or a Story to your connected Facebook account from a workflow, with a caption of up to 63,206 characters.
summaries.ja: ワークフローから、接続済みの Facebook アカウントに、テキスト、画像、動画、ストーリーズを公開します。キャプションは最大 63,206 文字です。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique um texto, uma imagem, um vídeo ou um Story na sua conta conectada do Facebook a partir de um workflow, com legenda de até 63.206 caracteres.

nodes.label: X Post
nodes.summary: Post text of up to 280 characters to your connected X account, with an optional image or video attached, as the last step of a Nodaro workflow.

summaries.en: Post text of up to 280 characters to your connected X account, with an optional image or video attached, as the last step of a Nodaro workflow.
summaries.ja: Nodaro のワークフローの最後のステップとして、接続済みの X アカウントに最大 280 文字のテキストを投稿します。画像や動画を添付することもできます。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique um texto de até 280 caracteres na sua conta conectada do X, com uma imagem ou um vídeo opcional, como a última etapa de um workflow do Nodaro.

nodes.label: LinkedIn Post
nodes.summary: Publish a text post, an image or a video of up to 10 minutes to your connected LinkedIn account, with up to 3,000 characters of text, from a workflow.

summaries.en: Publish a text post, an image or a video of up to 10 minutes to your connected LinkedIn account, with up to 3,000 characters of text, from a workflow.
summaries.ja: ワークフローから、接続済みの LinkedIn アカウントに、テキストの投稿、画像、最大 10 分の動画を公開します。テキストは最大 3,000 文字です。
summaries.pt-BR: Publique um texto, uma imagem ou um vídeo de até 10 minutos na sua conta conectada do LinkedIn a partir de um workflow, com até 3.000 caracteres de texto.

nodes.label: Telegram Post
nodes.summary: Send a message, a photo or a video to a Telegram chat, channel or group through your connected bot. The node picks the kind of message from what you connect.

summaries.en: Send a message, a photo or a video to a Telegram chat, channel or group through your connected bot. The node picks the kind of message from what you connect.
summaries.ja: 接続済みのボットを通じて、Telegram のチャット、チャンネル、グループに、メッセージ、写真、動画を送信します。メッセージの種類は、接続したものに応じてノードが選びます。
summaries.pt-BR: Envie uma mensagem, uma foto ou um vídeo a um chat, canal ou grupo do Telegram pelo seu bot conectado. O nó escolhe o tipo de envio pelo que você conecta.

nodes.label: Save to Storage
nodes.summary: Save an image, a video or an audio result to your Nodaro storage so it stays in your asset library. The node is free, and files count toward your quota.

summaries.en: Save an image, a video or an audio result to your Nodaro storage so it stays in your asset library. The node is free, and files count toward your quota.
summaries.ja: 画像、動画、オーディオの結果を Nodaro のストレージに保存し、アセットライブラリに残します。ノードは無料で、ファイルはストレージの容量に含まれます。
summaries.pt-BR: Salve uma imagem, um vídeo ou um áudio no armazenamento do Nodaro para mantê-lo na biblioteca de mídia. O nó é gratuito, e os arquivos contam na sua cota.

nodes.label: Webhook Output
nodes.summary: Send workflow results to any URL as an HTTP POST with a JSON body, with named values and an optional stored credential whose secret stays on the server.

summaries.en: Send workflow results to any URL as an HTTP POST with a JSON body, with named values and an optional stored credential whose secret stays on the server.
summaries.ja: ワークフローの結果を、名前付きの値として、JSON ボディ付きの HTTP POST で任意の URL に送信します。保存済みの認証情報も付けられ、そのシークレットはサーバー上に保持されます。
summaries.pt-BR: Envie os resultados do workflow a qualquer URL por HTTP POST com corpo JSON, com valores nomeados e uma credencial opcional cujo segredo fica no servidor.

nodes.label: Person
nodes.summary: Describe a person for AI images and video with 575 options in 33 settings, from age and body to face geometry, hair and eyes. The picker writes the prompt.

summaries.en: Describe a person for AI images and video with 575 options in 33 settings, from age and body to face geometry, hair and eyes. The picker writes the prompt.
summaries.ja: 年齢や体型から、顔の造形、髪、目まで、33 の設定にある 575 のオプションで、AI 画像と動画の人物を説明します。プロンプトはピッカーが書きます。
summaries.pt-BR: Descreva uma pessoa para imagens e vídeos com IA com 575 opções em 33 configurações, de idade e corpo a rosto, cabelo e olhos. O seletor escreve o prompt.

nodes.label: Animal
nodes.summary: Pick one of 126 animals, from pets and wildlife to dinosaurs and dragons, and Nodaro adds the animal and a short description of its look to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 126 animals, from pets and wildlife to dinosaurs and dragons, and Nodaro adds the animal and a short description of its look to your prompt.
summaries.ja: ペットや野生動物から恐竜やドラゴンまで、126 種類の動物から 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がその動物と見た目の短い説明をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 126 animais, de pets e vida selvagem a dinossauros e dragões, e o Nodaro adiciona ao prompt o animal e uma descrição curta da aparência dele.

nodes.label: Vehicle
nodes.summary: Pick one of 107 vehicles, from classic cars and trains to aircraft, ships and spaceships, and Nodaro adds the vehicle and a short description to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 107 vehicles, from classic cars and trains to aircraft, ships and spaceships, and Nodaro adds the vehicle and a short description to your prompt.
summaries.ja: クラシックカーや列車から、飛行機、船、宇宙船まで、107 種類の乗り物から 1 つを選びます。Nodaro が、その乗り物と短い説明をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 107 veículos, de carros clássicos e trens a aeronaves, navios e naves espaciais, e o Nodaro põe no prompt o veículo e uma descrição curta.

nodes.label: Weapon
nodes.summary: Pick one of 85 weapons, from katanas and longbows to muskets, blasters and magic staffs, and Nodaro adds the weapon and a short description to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 85 weapons, from katanas and longbows to muskets, blasters and magic staffs, and Nodaro adds the weapon and a short description to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 刀やロングボウから、マスケット、ブラスター、魔法の杖まで、85 種類の武器から 1 つを選びます。Nodaro が武器とその短い説明をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 85 armas, de katanas e arcos longos a mosquetes, blasters e cajados mágicos, e o Nodaro adiciona a arma e uma descrição curta ao prompt.

nodes.label: Styling
nodes.summary: Style a person for AI images and video with 274 options in 17 settings, from makeup, hair and jewelry to outfits, shoes and fabric. Nodaro writes the prompt.

summaries.en: Style a person for AI images and video with 274 options in 17 settings, from makeup, hair and jewelry to outfits, shoes and fabric. Nodaro writes the prompt.
summaries.ja: メイク、ヘア、ジュエリーから、衣装、靴、生地まで、17 の設定と 274 のオプションで、AI 画像や動画の人物をスタイリングします。プロンプトは Nodaro が書きます。
summaries.pt-BR: Maquiagem, cabelo, joias, roupas, sapatos e tecido para pessoas em imagens e vídeos de IA: 274 opções em 17 configurações, e o Nodaro escreve o prompt.

nodes.label: Pose
nodes.summary: Pick one of 81 poses, from standing and seated postures to running, leaping and hand gestures, and Nodaro adds tested wording for the pose to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 81 poses, from standing and seated postures to running, leaping and hand gestures, and Nodaro adds tested wording for the pose to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 立ち姿や座り姿から、走る、跳ぶ、手のしぐさまで、81 種類のポーズから 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がそのポーズを表す検証済みの表現をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 81 poses, de posturas em pé e sentadas a corrida, saltos e gestos com as mãos, e o Nodaro adiciona ao prompt um texto testado para a pose.

nodes.label: Setting
nodes.summary: Pick one of 66 settings, from a coffee shop or a rooftop to a desert or an alien planet, and Nodaro adds a tested description of the place to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 66 settings, from a coffee shop or a rooftop to a desert or an alien planet, and Nodaro adds a tested description of the place to your prompt.
summaries.ja: コーヒーショップや屋上から、砂漠や異星まで、66 種類の舞台設定から 1 つを選びます。Nodaro が、その場所の検証済みの説明をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 66 cenários, de cafeteria ou terraço a deserto ou planeta alienígena, e o Nodaro adiciona ao prompt uma descrição testada do lugar.

nodes.label: Era / Period
nodes.summary: Pick one of 28 eras, from Ancient Egypt and Victorian to 1980s Neon and Cyberpunk Future, and Nodaro adds its fashion, places and film look to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 28 eras, from Ancient Egypt and Victorian to 1980s Neon and Cyberpunk Future, and Nodaro adds its fashion, places and film look to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 「古代エジプト」「ヴィクトリアン」から「1980年代ネオン」「サイバーパンク未来」まで、28 の時代から 1 つを選びます。Nodaro が、その時代のファッション、場所、フィルムの質感をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 28 épocas, como Antigo Egito, Vitoriana, Neon dos anos 1980 ou Futuro cyberpunk; o Nodaro põe a moda, os lugares e o visual dela no prompt.

nodes.label: Furniture
nodes.summary: Pick one of 78 furniture pieces, from sofas and four-poster beds to chandeliers and bathtubs, and Nodaro adds the piece and a short description to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 78 furniture pieces, from sofas and four-poster beds to chandeliers and bathtubs, and Nodaro adds the piece and a short description to your prompt.
summaries.ja: ソファ、4本柱ベッド、シャンデリア、バスタブなど、78 点の家具から 1 つを選びます。Nodaro が、その家具と短い説明をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 78 peças de mobília, de sofás e camas com dossel a lustres e banheiras, e o Nodaro adiciona a peça e uma descrição curta ao seu prompt.

nodes.label: Held Prop
nodes.summary: Pick up to 2 of 60 props for a subject to hold, such as a smartphone, a coffee cup, a book or a bouquet, and Nodaro adds how the prop is held to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick up to 2 of 60 props for a subject to hold, such as a smartphone, a coffee cup, a book or a bouquet, and Nodaro adds how the prop is held to your prompt.
summaries.ja: スマートフォン、コーヒーカップ、本、花束など、60 種類の小道具から最大 2 つを選び、被写体に持たせます。Nodaro が、小道具の持ち方をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha até 2 de 60 objetos para o assunto segurar, como smartphone, xícara de café, livro ou buquê, e o Nodaro descreve no prompt como ele os segura.

nodes.label: Material
nodes.summary: Pick up to 2 of 67 materials, from silk and leather to gold, marble and glass, and Nodaro adds how each surface looks and takes light to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick up to 2 of 67 materials, from silk and leather to gold, marble and glass, and Nodaro adds how each surface looks and takes light to your prompt.
summaries.ja: シルクやレザーから、ゴールド、大理石、ガラスまで、67 種類の素材から最大 2 つを選ぶと、Nodaro が各表面の見え方と光の受け方をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha até 2 de 67 materiais, de seda e couro a ouro, mármore e vidro, e o Nodaro adiciona ao prompt como cada superfície aparece e reage à luz.

nodes.label: Backdrop
nodes.summary: Pick one of 40 studio backdrops, from white seamless paper and gradients to brick walls, velvet drapes and chroma green, and Nodaro adds it to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 40 studio backdrops, from white seamless paper and gradients to brick walls, velvet drapes and chroma green, and Nodaro adds it to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 白いシームレス紙やグラデーションから、レンガの壁、ベルベットのドレープ、クロマグリーンまで、40 種類のスタジオ背景から 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 40 fundos de estúdio, do papel branco infinito e degradês a tijolos, cortinas de veludo e chroma verde, e o Nodaro o adiciona ao seu prompt.

nodes.label: Loop Subject
nodes.summary: Pick one of 31 loop subjects, such as a neon tunnel, a starfield or falling snow, and build a seamless looping video for streams, screens and ambient visuals.

summaries.en: Pick one of 31 loop subjects, such as a neon tunnel, a starfield or falling snow, and build a seamless looping video for streams, screens and ambient visuals.
summaries.ja: ネオンのトンネル、星空、降る雪など、31 種類のループの被写体から 1 つを選び、配信、画面表示、環境映像向けに、シームレスにループする動画を作ります。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 31 temas, como túnel de neon, campo de estrelas ou neve caindo, e crie um vídeo em loop perfeito para lives, telas e visuais ambientes.

nodes.label: Framing
nodes.summary: Set the shot size, angle, coverage, composition and vantage of AI images and video from 66 options, and Nodaro writes the framing into your prompt.

summaries.en: Set the shot size, angle, coverage, composition and vantage of AI images and video from 66 options, and Nodaro writes the framing into your prompt.
summaries.ja: 66 のオプションから、AI 画像や動画のショットサイズ、アングル、カバレッジ、構図、撮影方向を設定します。Nodaro が、そのフレーミングをプロンプトに書き込みます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina tamanho do plano, ângulo, cobertura, composição e ponto de observação de imagens e vídeos com IA entre 66 opções. O Nodaro escreve isso no prompt.

nodes.label: Lens
nodes.summary: Pick one of 18 lenses, from a 14mm ultra-wide and an 85mm portrait lens to fisheye, anamorphic and vintage primes, and Nodaro adds its look to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 18 lenses, from a 14mm ultra-wide and an 85mm portrait lens to fisheye, anamorphic and vintage primes, and Nodaro adds its look to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 14mm の超広角や 85mm のポートレートレンズから、魚眼、アナモルフィック、ヴィンテージの単焦点まで、18 本のレンズから 1 本を選びます。Nodaro が、そのレンズの描写をプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 18 lentes, de 14mm ultra-grande-angular e 85mm de retrato a olho de peixe, anamórfica e vintage, e o Nodaro põe o visual dela no prompt.

nodes.label: Camera / Film Stock
nodes.summary: Pick one of 31 cameras and film stocks, from 35mm film and Arri Alexa to VHS, Polaroid and daguerreotype, and Nodaro adds that medium's look to your prompt.

summaries.en: Pick one of 31 cameras and film stocks, from 35mm film and Arri Alexa to VHS, Polaroid and daguerreotype, and Nodaro adds that medium's look to your prompt.
summaries.ja: 35mmフィルムや Arri Alexa から、VHS、Polaroid、ダゲレオタイプまで、31 種類のカメラとフィルムから 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がその撮影媒体のルックをプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha uma de 31 câmeras e películas, do filme 35mm e da Arri Alexa a VHS, Polaroid e daguerreótipo, e o Nodaro adiciona o visual desse meio ao prompt.

nodes.label: Exposure Settings
nodes.summary: Set the aperture, shutter speed and ISO of an AI image or video from 20 options, for a soft background, frozen action, light trails or film grain.

summaries.en: Set the aperture, shutter speed and ISO of an AI image or video from 20 options, for a soft background, frozen action, light trails or film grain.
summaries.ja: 20 のオプションから、AI 画像や動画の絞り、シャッタースピード、ISO を設定します。柔らかくぼけた背景、止まった動き、光の軌跡、フィルムの粒子感を表現できます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina abertura, velocidade do obturador e ISO de imagens e vídeos com IA, entre 20 opções, para fundo suave, ação congelada, rastros de luz ou granulação.

nodes.label: Lighting
nodes.summary: Set how an AI image or video is lit. Combine the time of day, lighting style, direction, lighting ratio and color temperature from 72 tested options.

summaries.en: Set how an AI image or video is lit. Combine the time of day, lighting style, direction, lighting ratio and color temperature from 72 tested options.
summaries.ja: AI 画像や動画のライティングを設定します。時間帯、ライティングのスタイル、光の方向、ライティング比、色温度を、72 種類の検証済みオプションから組み合わせます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina a luz de uma imagem ou vídeo com IA. Combine hora do dia, estilo, direção, razão de iluminação e temperatura de cor entre 72 opções testadas.

nodes.label: Color / Look
nodes.summary: Pick one of 41 color grades, such as Teal & Orange, Kodak Portra or Bleach Bypass, and Nodaro adds that grade to the prompt of your image and video nodes.

summaries.en: Pick one of 41 color grades, such as Teal & Orange, Kodak Portra or Bleach Bypass, and Nodaro adds that grade to the prompt of your image and video nodes.
summaries.ja: ティール＆オレンジ、Kodak Portra、ブリーチバイパスなど、41 種類のカラーグレードから 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がそのグレードを画像ノードと動画ノードのプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 41 tratamentos de cor, como Azul-petróleo e laranja, Kodak Portra ou Bleach Bypass, e o Nodaro o põe no prompt dos nós de imagem e vídeo.

nodes.label: Mood
nodes.summary: Pick up to two of 51 moods, such as calm, tense or joyful, and Nodaro adds tested wording for the emotion to the prompt of the image or video nodes you connect.

summaries.en: Pick up to two of 51 moods, such as calm, tense or joyful, and Nodaro adds tested wording for the emotion to the prompt of the image or video nodes you connect.
summaries.ja: 落ち着いた、緊張した、喜びにあふれたなど 51 種類のムードから最大 2 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がその感情を表す検証済みの表現を、接続した画像ノードや動画ノードのプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha até dois de 51 climas, como calmo, tenso ou alegre, e o Nodaro adiciona textos testados da emoção ao prompt dos nós de imagem ou vídeo conectados.

nodes.label: Atmosphere
nodes.summary: Add weather and particles to an AI image or video. Pick up to 2 of 40 conditions, such as Fog, Light Rain, Snow, Smoke or God Rays, from one picker.

summaries.en: Add weather and particles to an AI image or video. Pick up to 2 of 40 conditions, such as Fog, Light Rain, Snow, Smoke or God Rays, from one picker.
summaries.ja: AI の画像や動画に、天候や空気中の粒子を加えます。霧、小雨、雪、煙、ゴッドレイなど、40 種類の状態から最大 2 つを 1 つのピッカーで選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Adicione condições do tempo e partículas a uma imagem ou vídeo com IA. Escolha até 2 de 40 condições, como Neblina, Chuva leve, Neve, Fumaça ou God Rays.

nodes.label: Style
nodes.summary: Set the visual style of an AI image or video, such as Cinematic, Anime, Oil Painting or Pixel Art. Pick one of 49 styles and Nodaro adds it to the prompt.

summaries.en: Set the visual style of an AI image or video, such as Cinematic, Anime, Oil Painting or Pixel Art. Pick one of 49 styles and Nodaro adds it to the prompt.
summaries.ja: シネマティック、アニメ、油絵、ピクセルアートなど、AI 画像や動画のビジュアルスタイルを設定します。49 種類から 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro がそのスタイルをプロンプトに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Dê a imagens e vídeos de IA um estilo visual, como Cinematográfico, Anime, Pintura a óleo ou Pixel Art: escolha um de 49, e o Nodaro o adiciona ao prompt.

nodes.label: Photo Genre
nodes.summary: Make an AI image read as a specific kind of photo, such as a fashion editorial, a street photo, a mirror selfie or a movie poster. Pick one of 46 genres.

summaries.en: Make an AI image read as a specific kind of photo, such as a fashion editorial, a street photo, a mirror selfie or a movie poster. Pick one of 46 genres.
summaries.ja: ファッションエディトリアル、ストリート写真、ミラー自撮り、映画ポスターなど、AI 画像を特定の種類の写真のように見せます。46 種類のジャンルから 1 つを選びます。
summaries.pt-BR: Faça uma imagem de IA parecer um certo tipo de foto, como editorial de moda, foto de rua, selfie no espelho ou cartaz de filme. Escolha um de 46 gêneros.

nodes.label: Photographer / Artist Style
nodes.summary: Ground an AI image or video in the signature of a photographer, cinematographer or illustrator. Pick up to 2 of 63 creators, such as Roger Deakins.

summaries.en: Ground an AI image or video in the signature of a photographer, cinematographer or illustrator. Pick up to 2 of 63 creators, such as Roger Deakins.
summaries.ja: 写真家、撮影監督、イラストレーターの作風をもとに、AI 画像や動画を作ります。Roger Deakins など 63 人のクリエイターから、最大 2 人を選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Baseie uma imagem ou um vídeo de IA na assinatura de um fotógrafo, diretor de fotografia ou ilustrador. Escolha até 2 de 63 criadores, como Roger Deakins.

nodes.label: Render Quality
nodes.summary: Push an AI image toward a CG render look, such as Ray Tracing, Unreal Engine 5 or Octane Render, or add a quality term. Pick one of 24 render presets.

summaries.en: Push an AI image toward a CG render look, such as Ray Tracing, Unreal Engine 5 or Octane Render, or add a quality term. Pick one of 24 render presets.
summaries.ja: AI 画像を、レイトレーシング、Unreal Engine 5、Octane Render などの CG レンダリングの見た目に近づけたり、品質を表す用語を加えたりします。24 種類のレンダリングプリセットから 1 つを選びます。
summaries.pt-BR: Dê a uma imagem de IA um visual de render 3D, como Ray tracing, Unreal Engine 5 ou Octane Render, ou um termo de qualidade. Escolha entre 24 predefinições.

nodes.label: Aesthetic / Microtrend
nodes.summary: Tune an AI image or video to an online aesthetic, such as Y2K, Cottagecore, Dark Academia or Balletcore. Pick up to 2 of 42 named aesthetics.

summaries.en: Tune an AI image or video to an online aesthetic, such as Y2K, Cottagecore, Dark Academia or Balletcore. Pick up to 2 of 42 named aesthetics.
summaries.ja: Y2K、コテージコア、ダークアカデミア、バレエコアなど、ネットで話題のテイストに AI の画像や動画を合わせます。名前の付いた 42 種類のテイストから、最大 2 つを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Ajuste uma imagem ou um vídeo com IA a uma estética da internet, como Y2K, Cottagecore, Dark Academia ou Balletcore. Escolha até 2 de 42 estéticas.

nodes.label: Camera Motion
nodes.summary: Tell an AI video model how the camera moves. Pick one of 66 camera motions, such as Dolly In, Orbit Left or Crane Up, and Nodaro adds tested wording.

summaries.en: Tell an AI video model how the camera moves. Pick one of 66 camera motions, such as Dolly In, Orbit Left or Crane Up, and Nodaro adds tested wording.
summaries.ja: AI 動画モデルに、カメラの動き方を指示します。ドリー・イン、オービット・レフト、クレーン・アップなど 66 種類のカメラモーションから 1 つを選ぶと、Nodaro が検証済みの表現を追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha um de 66 movimentos de câmera para vídeos com IA, como Dolly In, Órbita para a esquerda ou Grua para cima, e o Nodaro adiciona textos testados.

nodes.label: Temporal
nodes.summary: Control time in an AI video clip. Combine speed, freeze, direction and shutter, such as Slow Motion, Bullet Time or Reverse, from 18 tested options.

summaries.en: Control time in an AI video clip. Combine speed, freeze, direction and shutter, such as Slow Motion, Bullet Time or Reverse, from 18 tested options.
summaries.ja: AI 動画のクリップで、時間の流れを操ります。スローモーション、バレットタイム、リバース／巻き戻しなど、検証済みの 18 のオプションで、速度、フリーズ、方向、シャッターを組み合わせます。
summaries.pt-BR: Controle o tempo em clipes de vídeo de IA. Combine velocidade, congelamento, direção e obturador, como Câmera lenta, Bullet Time ou Reverso, em 18 opções.

nodes.label: Character Motion
nodes.summary: Direct what a character does in an AI video clip. Chain up to 3 of more than 1,000 moves, such as walk in, wave or hug, and name who performs them.

summaries.en: Direct what a character does in an AI video clip. Chain up to 3 of more than 1,000 moves, such as walk in, wave or hug, and name who performs them.
summaries.ja: AI 動画のクリップで、キャラクターの動作を演出します。歩いて登場する、手を振る、ハグするなど、1,000 種類を超える動きから最大 3 つをつなげ、誰が演じるかを指定できます。
summaries.pt-BR: Dirija o que um personagem faz em um clipe com IA. Encadeie até 3 de mais de 1.000 movimentos, como entrar andando, acenar ou abraçar, e diga quem os faz.

nodes.label: Action FX
nodes.summary: Add an event to an AI scene, such as an explosion, a lightning strike, an earthquake or a magic portal. Pick up to 2 of 72 tested action effects.

summaries.en: Add an event to an AI scene, such as an explosion, a lightning strike, an earthquake or a magic portal. Pick up to 2 of 72 tested action effects.
summaries.ja: AI のシーンに、爆発、落雷、地震、魔法のポータルなどの出来事を加えます。検証済みの 72 種類のアクションエフェクトから、最大 2 つを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Adicione um evento a uma cena gerada por IA, como uma explosão, um raio, um terremoto ou um portal mágico. Escolha até 2 de 72 efeitos de ação testados.

nodes.label: Character FX
nodes.summary: Transform a character or give it a power in an AI video: werewolf, fire breathing, wings, glowing eyes and more. Pick up to 2 of 55 character effects.

summaries.en: Transform a character or give it a power in an AI video: werewolf, fire breathing, wings, glowing eyes and more. Pick up to 2 of 55 character effects.
summaries.ja: AI 動画のキャラクターを変身させたり、能力を与えたりします。狼男、炎の息吹、翼、光る目など、55 種類のキャラクターエフェクトから最大 2 つを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Transforme um personagem ou dê um poder a ele em vídeos com IA: lobisomem, cuspir fogo, asas, olhos brilhantes e mais. Escolha até 2 de 55 efeitos.

nodes.label: Composition Effects
nodes.summary: Give an AI image or video a bold frame effect, such as Bursting Through Frame, Pixel Disintegration or Double Exposure. Pick one of 18 composition effects.

summaries.en: Give an AI image or video a bold frame effect, such as Bursting Through Frame, Pixel Disintegration or Double Exposure. Pick one of 18 composition effects.
summaries.ja: AI 画像や動画に、「フレームを突き破る」「ピクセル崩壊」「二重露光」などの大胆なフレームのエフェクトを加えます。18 種類の構図エフェクトから 1 つを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Dê a uma imagem ou vídeo com IA um efeito de quadro marcante, como Rompendo o quadro, Desintegração em pixels ou Dupla exposição. Escolha um de 18 efeitos.

nodes.label: Post-Process Effects
nodes.summary: Add finishing effects to an AI image or video, such as Fine Film Grain, Soft Vignette, Halation Glow or Light Leak. Pick up to 2 of 18 post-process effects.

summaries.en: Add finishing effects to an AI image or video, such as Fine Film Grain, Soft Vignette, Halation Glow or Light Leak. Pick up to 2 of 18 post-process effects.
summaries.ja: 細かいフィルム粒子、ソフト・ヴィネット、ハレーション・グロー、ライトリークなどの仕上げのエフェクトを、AI 画像や動画に加えます。18 種類のポストプロセスエフェクトから最大 2 つを選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Adicione efeitos como Granulação fina de filme, Vinheta suave, Brilho de halação ou Vazamento de luz a imagens e vídeos de IA. Escolha até 2 de 18 efeitos.

nodes.label: Transition
nodes.summary: Make an AI video model perform a transition inside one clip, such as a Whip Pan, a Match Cut or a Liquid Morph. Choose from more than 80 transitions.

summaries.en: Make an AI video model perform a transition inside one clip, such as a Whip Pan, a Match Cut or a Liquid Morph. Choose from more than 80 transitions.
summaries.ja: ホイップパン、マッチカット、液体モーフなどのトランジションを、AI 動画モデルに 1 つのクリップの中で実行させます。80 種類以上のトランジションから選べます。
summaries.pt-BR: Faça um modelo de vídeo de IA executar uma transição em um único clipe, como Chicote de câmera, Corte de raccord ou Morphing líquido. Há mais de 80 opções.

nodes.label: Music Genre
nodes.summary: Set the genre of AI music: up to 3 of 29 genres for a fusion, or one genre with a subgenre, plus an era. Works with Suno, Generate Music and Text to Audio.

summaries.en: Set the genre of AI music: up to 3 of 29 genres for a fusion, or one genre with a subgenre, plus an era. Works with Suno, Generate Music and Text to Audio.
summaries.ja: AI 音楽のジャンルを設定します。29 種類から最大 3 つを選んでフュージョンにするか、1 つのジャンルにサブジャンルを加え、さらに年代を指定します。Suno、音楽生成、テキストからオーディオで使えます。
summaries.pt-BR: Defina o gênero de uma música com IA: até 3 de 29 gêneros em fusão, ou um gênero com subgênero, e uma era. Para Suno, Gerar música e Texto para áudio.

nodes.label: Music Mood
nodes.summary: Describe how AI music should feel: one energy level, up to 3 emotions and up to 3 vibes, such as Driving, Triumphant and Cinematic. Works with Suno and more.

summaries.en: Describe how AI music should feel: one energy level, up to 3 emotions and up to 3 vibes, such as Driving, Triumphant and Cinematic. Works with Suno and more.
summaries.ja: AI 音楽の印象を指定します。エネルギーを 1 つ、感情と雰囲気をそれぞれ最大 3 つまで、疾走感、勝ち誇る、シネマティックのように選びます。Suno などで使えます。
summaries.pt-BR: Descreva a sensação de uma música com IA: uma energia, até 3 emoções e até 3 vibes, como Propulsiva, Triunfante e Cinematográfica. Para Suno e outros nós.

nodes.label: Instrumentation
nodes.summary: Choose the sound of AI music: up to 5 of 112 instruments, a production style, the vocals and a singing style. Works with Suno, Generate Music and Text to Audio.

summaries.en: Choose the sound of AI music: up to 5 of 112 instruments, a production style, the vocals and a singing style. Works with Suno, Generate Music and Text to Audio.
summaries.ja: AI 音楽のサウンドを決めます。112 種類の楽器から最大 5 つ、プロダクションのスタイル、ボーカル、歌い方を選べます。Suno、音楽生成、テキストからオーディオで使えます。
summaries.pt-BR: Escolha o som de uma música com IA: até 5 de 112 instrumentos, a produção, os vocais e um estilo de canto. Para Suno, Gerar música e Texto para áudio.

nodes.label: Voice Character
nodes.summary: Describe who a designed voice is: age, gender, up to 3 languages, one of 45 accents and a timbre. Nodaro adds it to the voice description of Voice Design.

summaries.en: Describe who a designed voice is: age, gender, up to 3 languages, one of 45 accents and a timbre. Nodaro adds it to the voice description of Voice Design.
summaries.ja: デザインするボイスがどんな人物の声かを、年齢、性別、最大 3 つの言語、45 種類から選ぶアクセント、音色で説明します。Nodaro が、それをボイスデザインのボイスの説明に追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Descreva quem é uma voz criada: idade, gênero, até 3 idiomas, um de 45 sotaques e um timbre. O Nodaro adiciona isso à descrição de voz do Design de voz.

nodes.label: Voice Delivery
nodes.summary: Describe how a designed voice speaks: its pace, its emotion and a voice-acting style, such as Documentary Narrator. Nodaro adds it to Voice Design.

summaries.en: Describe how a designed voice speaks: its pace, its emotion and a voice-acting style, such as Documentary Narrator. Nodaro adds it to Voice Design.
summaries.ja: デザインするボイスの話し方を、ペース、感情、そして「ドキュメンタリーナレーター」などの声の演技スタイルで説明します。Nodaro が、それをボイスデザインに追加します。
summaries.pt-BR: Descreva como uma voz criada fala: o ritmo, a emoção e um estilo de interpretação, como Narrador de documentário. O Nodaro adiciona isso ao Design de voz.

nodes.label: Suno Voice
nodes.summary: Create a custom voice persona from a short recording of your own voice, then use it as the singer on Suno Create Music, Suno Cover and Suno Extend.

summaries.en: Create a custom voice persona from a short recording of your own voice, then use it as the singer on Suno Create Music, Suno Cover and Suno Extend.
summaries.ja: 自分の声の短い録音から、オリジナルのボイスペルソナを作成します。作ったボイスは、Suno 生成、Suno カバー、Suno 延長の歌い手として使えます。
summaries.pt-BR: Crie uma persona de voz própria a partir de uma gravação curta da sua voz e use-a para cantar em Gerar música com Suno, Cover com Suno e Estender com Suno.
